responsibility: Declares array-based LONGREAL/string conversion routines for the ISO library. It specifies parsing from a character array with a conversion result code and formatting back into floating, engineering, fixed, or width-adaptive string forms, serving as the fixed-buffer counterpart to the DynamicStrings-based ConvStringLong layer.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for LongStr: it declares the exported LONGREAL-to-string and string-to-LONGREAL routines for fixed character arrays, while LongStr.mod contains the conversion code that performs those operations.
